profile.headline: Software Developer | React, Next.js & Angular | E-Commerce & Web Applications | Co-Founder, PlacidBits
profile.summary:
I'm a software developer with a background spanning front-end development, back-end systems, and database-driven applications. I specialize in building intuitive, functional web experiences using technologies like React, Next.js, JavaScript, and modern content management systems.

Throughout my career, I've worked on customer-facing applications, e-commerce platforms, and internal business tools. My experience extends beyond writing code to collaborating with stakeholders, understanding user needs, troubleshooting complex problems, and developing practical solutions.

I'm also a co-founder of PlacidBits, where we focus on creating thoughtful digital experiences for businesses.
I enjoy work that blends technical problem-solving, creativity, and collaboration, whether that's developing new features, improving existing systems, or helping turn an idea into a working product.

positions.title: Front-End Software Developer (Volunteer)
positions.description:
Contribute to the development and maintenance of web applications supporting large-scale international events.
- Develop and enhance user interfaces using Angular for web applications that support large-scale event management.
- Build and maintain event information pages, making sure content is organized, accessible, and easy to navigate.
- Use AI-assisted development tools to write code, troubleshoot issues, and streamline debugging.
Work with a remote development team to build new features and improve existing functionality.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Develop and maintain Angular and TypeScript applications supporting event planning and coordination.

positions.title: Co-Founder & Software Developer
positions.description:
Co-founded PlacidBits, a software development company specializing in custom applications, e-commerce solutions, and websites tailored to clients' business needs.
- Lead end-to-end development for Shopify and Wix projects, including theme customization, storefront functionality, and brand-aligned user experiences.
- Develop custom e-commerce solutions using Shopify APIs to support promotions, fulfillment workflows, and accurate shipping calculations.
- Collaborate directly with clients to translate business needs into technical requirements, develop practical solutions, and provide ongoing support and optimization.
positions.insights: Skills: Web Development · Application Programming Interfaces (API) · Full-Stack Development · Client Relations · E-Commerce · Shopify · React.js · REST API · User Interface Design · Software Design · Software Industry · Engineering · Web Engineering · Next.js · Business Requirements · Front-End Development

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed customer-facing web applications that made it easier for customers to access discounts, submit rebates, and share feedback.
- Integrated ID.me into Belle Tire's website to provide military discounts, supporting over 20,000 users and generating more than $3 million in purchase revenue.
- Built a rebate website that attracted over 4 million visitors in 2023, simplifying the process of redeeming eligible purchase rebates.
- Developed a customer review platform that collected more than 18,000 customer ratings in 2023.
- Worked with cross-functional teams to develop, troubleshoot, and improve web applications.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description: Developed and maintained customer-facing web applications using React, Next.js, JavaScript, GraphQL, and Contentful.

positions.title: Cofounder
positions.description:
Co-founded Wear To, an online clothing boutique offering modern, versatile workwear for women. My role combined web development, creative direction, photography, and digital content creation.
- Developed and managed the boutique's e-commerce website, implementing custom code and functionality as needed.
- Led the creative direction of lifestyle photoshoots, from developing concepts and scouting locations to sourcing props and directing on set.
- Contributed to campaign photography and edited images for the website, social media, and other marketing materials.
- Collaborated on social media content, creating visuals that reflected the brand's identity and showcased its collections.
positions.insights: Skills: Creative Direction · HTML5 · Site Development · Client Relations · E-Commerce · Shopify · Front-End Development · Web Development · Product Photography · Photography · Adobe Photoshop · Adobe Lightroom · Content Creation · Social Media Content Creation · Adobe Premiere Pro

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained internal applications that supported business operations, working across both front-end interfaces and back-end systems.
- Built a Windows service using Microsoft Dynamics GP to synchronize financial data between the company and a subsidiary.
- Improved internal web applications by updating interfaces, fixing responsive design issues, and adding client-side and server-side validation.
- Participated in technical design discussions and helped define user stories for application improvements.
positions.insights: Skills: Troubleshooting · Engineering · Programming · Problem Solving · Software Industry · Software Design · Creative Problem Solving · Front-End Development · C# · SQL · Web Application Development · Microsoft Dynamics GP · Windows Services · Responsive Web Design

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on software development, technical support, and data solutions, helping clients get the most out of the company's applications.
- Maintained and enhanced the company's flagship application, making updates to both its C# and Java versions.
- Worked directly with clients to troubleshoot technical issues, answer software-related questions, and help them use applications effectively.
- Created custom reports and data deliverables by gathering information from internal databases based on client requirements.
- Investigated application issues and worked to resolve problems affecting functionality and the user experience.
